register.labelZh: GO 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: GO 片語動詞可以清楚表示某人經過另一人、繞過障礙物、穿過地方、走到某人身邊,或沿樓梯向上走。；你可以用 GO 片語動詞描述事情持續、價格上升、感覺消失、消息傳開,或局勢發展至戰爭。；GO 片語動詞可以表示接受決定、支持計劃、與某人來往、與某人拍拖,或選擇彼此相配的事物。；你可以說明有甚麼證據可作依據、金錢花在哪裏、物資是否足夠所有人,以及人們如何在缺少某物的情況下生活。
register.summaryEn: GO expressions can show whether someone moves past a person, round an obstacle, through a place, over to someone or up a staircase. You can use GO expressions to describe something continuing, prices rising, feelings disappearing, news spreading or a situation moving towards war. GO expressions can show that you accept a decision, support a plan, spend time with someone, date someone or choose something that matches well. You can explain what evidence you have to use, what money is spent on, whether there is enough for everyone and how people manage without something.
contextsZh: 使用 GO 準確描述不同移動方式
表達選擇、支持和人際關係
描述日常需要和實際限制
contextsEn: Use GO to describe movement in precise ways
Talk about continuation, change and development
Describe everyday needs and practical limits

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；先掌握核心表達。在 We went round the building to reach the side entrance 中,核心表達是 goround the building。to reach the side entrance 只說明目的,並非核心表達的一部分。；外形相近的 GO 片語動詞可以有完全不同的意思。例如,go on 可表示「繼續」;go on evidence 表示「根據證據判斷」;money goes on rent 則表示「金錢花在租金上」。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Learn the core expression first. In “We went round the building to reach the side entrance”, the core expression is go round the building. The words to reach the side entrance only explain why. Similar-looking GO expressions can have very different meanings. For example, go on can mean “continue”; go on evidence means “use evidence as a basis”; and money goes on rent means “money is spent on rent”.

benefits.en: You can explain what evidence you have to use, what money is spent on, whether there is enough for everyone and how people manage without something.
